robot.model: Franka Emika Panda from pinned MuJoCo Menagerie
robot.arm: source joints, inertias, collision meshes and torque limits retained
robot.controller: damped Jacobian IK, limited position servos, actuator-based gravity compensation
robot.perception: privileged simulator object and joint state; no image-based perception claim
robot.gripper_changes: position gain 2000, damping 40, actuator force limited to +/-40 N; simulated rubber-pad friction 1.4/0.01/0.006, six-dimensional contact
robot.grasp_attachment: contact only; no object-to-hand equality/weld and no live object pose writes

contact_model.objects: rigid bodies; decomposed rings preserve holes
contact_model.support: measured post-release contact-manifold force, velocity and pose checks
contact_model.mass_basis: Simulation test parameters except nominal copper mass derived from geometry; not measured apparatus/material properties. Rigid foam stress/damage is unvalidated.
contact_model.collision_audit: Arm/environment force and penetration checked every 10 physics steps; gripper-to-object contact and final support checked at task checkpoints. This is not complete collision qualification.

authored_fixtures.assembly: Source-size 25 mm foam layers and 50 mm by 0.5 mm emitter; task-authored alignment nest/pins and balanced overhead edge carrier. The carrier and alignment fixtures are not qualified for the final optical/thermal experiment.
authored_fixtures.probe: 3 mm rigid sheath, 5 mm square clearance bore, inferred handling collar and stand; does not represent the source's complete thermocouple/bath calibration setup.
authored_fixtures.lid: inferred grasp handle, lid stand and aperture support; one lid cycle does not establish paired cooler operation.
authored_fixtures.door: inferred supported hinged access fixture with 0.22 Nm friction; not a certified Cary/Nicolet door mechanism.

source_meshes.provenance: original cooling_scene_assets_v2 GLB, converted without remeshing
source_meshes.use: USB-TC and A25 visual context only in the current workcells
source_meshes.collision_status: source visual meshes do not establish manufacturer-specific contact geometry

completion_rule: Whole-paper acceptance requires every required manipulation occurrence and branch to pass in a causally continuous bound scene. Separate workcell successes do not satisfy this rule.
